description: Check whether an IP belongs to a named AI crawler. Pass agent (slug, agent name or robots token) to test that crawler's official ranges; omit it to try static CIDR blocks first, then reverse DNS and the crawlers whose rDNS suffixes match. Returns matched/mismatch/unavailable/not-checked plus the CIDR and rDNS evidence. Use when the user pastes a log entry and asks whether the bot is genuine. One network call; fails soft on DNS/range errors.

agent.description: Optional crawler slug, agent name or robots token

name: visdenda_verify_crawler_ip
title: Verify a crawler IP
